name: run a speculative draft-and-verify loop against a target sequence
definition: alternately generate a small draft block from the draft model, compare each proposed token to the target sequence up to the first mismatch, and extend the context
failure_mode: off-by-one in the acceptance or context update logic changes the total

name: run feature matching and robust geometric model fits over correspondences
definition: run feature matching and robust geometric model fits over correspondences
failure_mode: extractor failure or matching that yields zero inliers fails the run

name: select model parameters that reproduce the reference full-physics state within a tight absolute tolerance
definition: Choose tuning knobs that keep the final state (positions/velocities/etc.) within the required tolerance of the unchanged reference model across randomized initial states, without NaN/Inf.
failure_mode: Changed physics or timestep diverges the state beyond tolerance or yields NaN

name: select the top leaderboard model and emit its org/model identifier
definition: Pick the model with the highest mean across tasks and write its org/model name as a single trimmed line.
failure_mode: multiline, whitespace noise, or a wrongly-formatted name fails the exact-match check
